invented.quote: including people who'd been with me for years
invented.why: The brief mentions existing clients, but does not state that any clients have been with the bookkeeper for years.
The brief states the price was raised for everyone, including existing clients, but does not give this reason for raising it.

invented.quote: If I'm going to be late, you'll hear it from me before the 10th, with the date your books will be ready.
invented.why: The brief states the bookkeeper missed the deadline three times last year, but mentions no policy of notifying clients in advance with a new completion date.
